params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $src=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'HeavenBridgeSource'; $root=Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE 'MhwUiEvidence'; if(Test-Path $root){ Get-ChildItem $root -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { try { git -C $src worktree remove --force $_.FullName 2>$null } catch {}; Remove-Item -LiteralPath $_.FullName -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } } else { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $root | Out-Null }; git -C $src fetch origin; git -C $src worktree add --detach (Join-Path $root 'main') e282fa0499e15e9ab57ecbd3b21ab7e341bc6b56; git -C $src worktree add --detach (Join-Path $root 'candidate') 35af25b2695773248afba10e88783e0b99767324; dotnet build (Join-Path $root 'main\src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj') -c Release -p:NuGetAudit=false; dotnet build (Join-Path $root 'candidate\src\MhwModManager.App\MhwModManager.App.csproj') -c Release -p:NuGetAudit=false; Write-Output ('MAIN_EXE=' + (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $root 'main\src\MhwModManager.App\bin\Release') -Filter 'MHW Mod Manager.exe' -Recurse -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName)); Write-Output ('CANDIDATE_EXE=' + (Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $root 'candidate\src\MhwModManager.App\bin\Release') -Filter 'MHW Mod Manager.exe' -Recurse -File | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty FullName))
